lillian_cs: Heads-up — Nimbus onboarding hit a preflight stampede during a serverless canary this morning. Their containers spawn ~300 short-lived goroutines, each doing an ephemeral token fetch on init.

lillian_cs: Customers reported spikes of 429s and a few 401s from preflight; their smoke-run failed.

rachel_se: Are they using the Go SDK or rolling their own? Can you paste an example of the auth call and headers?

lillian_cs: They're using a thin wrapper over our Go SDK but doing token refresh per request. Sample log: 
```
GET /v1/preflight 401 - auth: Bearer <empty>
POST /v1/generate 429 - x-tenant-id: nimbus-42 - req-id: z7k3c
User-Agent: Nimbus-Runner/0.9 go-sdk
```

lillian_cs: Each container starts 5 goroutines every 200ms for startup checks — that's the fanout.

taylan_sdk: Classic ephemeral-token-per-request pattern. For serverless we recommend either: cache token per container for 45-120s OR use the SDK TokenCache helper. Quick Go snippet: 
```go
cache := redwood.NewTokenCache(60*time.Second)
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithTokenProvider(cache))
// reuse client across goroutines
```
This prevents preflight fanout and reduces auth QPS heavy-hitters.

lillian_cs: Sent them the snippet and suggested an exponential jittered startup (rand.Intn(1000)) between containers.

taylan_sdk: Also advise reusing the HTTP client and avoiding token fetch on every call. We can add a short-term tweak: relax tenant preflight throttle for 30 minutes while they finish canary. Need infra signoff.

rachel_se: Agreed. Patch policy for per-tenant relax is safer than changing global guards. Watchlist: tenant preflight QPS, edge 429 rate, auth svc 5xx, and upstream latency p95.

deploy-bot: infra-ticket #INF-4902 created by rachel_se: "temporary preflight allowance for tenant nimbus-42 - 30m"

lillian_cs: Nimbus applied the token cache + jittered startup and their canary completed green within 6 minutes. No further 429s observed.

taylan_sdk: Nice. Filing a small SDK UX tweak: warn when token TTL < 15s and offer TokenCache by default for serverless init patterns. Filing RD-2040.

rachel_se: I'll add a short "serverless onboarding play" to the CS playbook with the code snippet and a checklist: (1) token caching, (2) reuse HTTP client, (3) stagger startup, (4) monitor tenant 429s.

lillian_cs: Customer asked for a one-pager we can attach to onboarding. I'll prepare and share before the post-onboard call.

infra-bot: INF-4902 resolved by rachel_se: "allowance reverted"

lillian_cs: Marking onboarding healthy. Scheduling a 48h check-in for renewal readiness. :white_check_mark:

rachel_se: Thanks team — low-effort changes, big win for the customer.

taylan_sdk: We'll follow up in RD on the TTL warning and TokenCache default.

lillian_cs: Closing thread.
